datasets.name: uci-online-retail
datasets.notes: 541,909 UK online-retail transactions (2010-12-01 to 2011-12-09); schema InvoiceNo, StockCode, Description, Quantity, InvoiceDate, UnitPrice, CustomerID, Country. Used only to compare RFM clustering methods offline. Raw data and artifacts are not committed. Its customer-level RFM fields are not collected by VentureForge, so it is not used to fabricate runtime assignments.

datasets.name: startup-industry-bootstrap
datasets.notes: Deterministically generated (fixed seed) by ml/src/preprocessing/bootstrap_data.py from template phrase pools authored by Student 1, to bootstrap and unit-test the industry classification pipeline end to end. Not representative of the real-world label distribution or company diversity. Must be replaced or substantially augmented with a real, schema-inspected corpus before any production accuracy claim is made.

datasets.name: yc-companies-2012-2024
datasets.notes: 4,522 real Y Combinator-backed companies, 26 batches (W12-W24, 2012-2024), columns include name/one_liner/long_description/industry/subindustry/status. Schema-inspected: 9 raw industry labels; 'unspecified' (19 rows, not a real label) and 'government' (32 rows, below the 50-row minimum for reliable stratified 5-fold CV) excluded per ml/src/preprocessing/prepare_yc_dataset.py, leaving 7 classes. B2B is the dominant class (~50%), reflecting YC's actual portfolio composition, not a data defect; mitigated with class_weight='balanced' in every candidate model, not by fabricating balance. Transform script: ml/src/preprocessing/prepare_yc_dataset.py. Full schema profile in ml/DATASETS.md.

datasets.name: kaggle-company-classification-scrape
datasets.notes: 73,974 rows, 13 well-balanced classes, real scraped homepage text — schema was strong, but the dataset's Kaggle license field is 'unknown' (no license specified by the publisher). Rejected on licensing grounds, not schema quality: redistribution/training rights are not established. See ml/DATASETS.md.

datasets.name: kaggle-crunchbase-startup-outcomes
datasets.notes: 66,368 rows, CDLA-Sharing-1.0 license (acceptable), but no free-text description column exists (only name + multi-label category_list + funding metadata) — not usable for a name+description text classifier. See ml/DATASETS.md.

datasets.name: kaggle-startup-success-prediction
datasets.notes: 923 rows of structured Crunchbase-derived features (funding rounds, milestones, relationships) with a binary acquired/closed outcome. No free-text input, small n, and the outcome is confounded by company age and survivorship bias — not a defensible funding-readiness target. This is a Student 2 'success prediction' dataset shape, not Student 1 scope. See ml/DATASETS.md.

datasets.name: kaggle-funding-outcomes
datasets.notes: No supervised funding-readiness dataset with a defensible target, sufficient observations, form-available features, and leakage-free labeling was identified. See ml/DATASETS.md. Funding readiness is implemented as a transparent deterministic rubric instead (see backend/app/ml/funding_readiness.py).

datasets.name: crunchbase-startup-success-outcomes
datasets.notes: 66,368 real Crunchbase-derived company records; 13,334 rows have a resolved historical outcome (acquired 5,549 + ipo 1,547 = success; closed 6,238 = failure) and are used for training. The 53,034 'operating' rows are excluded as unresolved, not labeled as failure. Transform script: ml/src/preprocessing/prepare_success_dataset.py. Full schema profile, model comparison, and metrics in ml/DATASETS.md.

datasets.name: startup-success-prediction-alternative
datasets.notes: 923 rows, real Crunchbase-derived data, same acquired/closed binary target shape as the approved dataset above. Not rejected on quality grounds — simply superseded by the 66,368-row Crunchbase dataset (14x more resolved-outcome rows) for the same task. See ml/DATASETS.md.

datasets.name: global-startup-success-dataset-synthetic
datasets.notes: 5,000 rows, Apache-2.0, but no data-provenance statement and an undefined 'Success Score 1-10 based on growth' field that reads as an arbitrary generated label rather than an observed outcome. See ml/DATASETS.md.

datasets.name: startup-funding-outcome-simulated
datasets.notes: 100,000 rows, Apache-2.0, but the publisher's own metadata states userSpecifiedSources='Synthetic' ('Simulated startup data'). Also inspected and rejected for revenue_estimation for the same reason. See ml/DATASETS.md.

datasets.name: startup-growth-funding-trends-synthetic
datasets.notes: CC0-1.0, but the publisher's own metadata states the dataset is 'synthetically generated based on real-world startup funding and growth patterns' — not real observed data. Also inspected and rejected for revenue_estimation for the same reason. See ml/DATASETS.md.

datasets.name: financial-metrics-50-startups-toy
datasets.notes: The well-known '50 Startups' classroom regression dataset (50 rows). Extremely tiny toy dataset; R&D/Administration/Marketing spend -> Profit has no relationship to this system's founder-pitch input fields. See ml/DATASETS.md.

datasets.name: revenue-scenario-calculator
datasets.notes: No real, licensed, non-synthetic dataset tying startup revenue to founder-pitch-available features was found (see the rejected entries above, task=revenue_estimation, plus the two success_prediction synthetic rejections which were also evaluated for this task). Implemented as a transparent, versioned, user-assumption-driven scenario calculator instead of a trained model, mirroring the precedent set by backend/app/ml/funding_readiness.py. See ml/DATASETS.md 'Revenue Estimation — Dataset Decision'.
